stem: A machine guard has been removed for service, and the equipment is powered off but not released back to production. What should a cultivation technician do?
choices: Operate it briefly to test whether it works
Wait until the equipment is formally returned to service under the authorized maintenance process
Use the machine only at half speed
rationale: A technician should not assume powered-off equipment is safe or returned to service. Maintenance controls and formal release must be respected.
